rating.comments: The student made several mistakes: "bas 89" (it should be 90 numbers), "2700 fois 4", and "200000". The AI never identified or acknowledged any of them; it silently corrected 89 to 90 and then repeated the same block word for word three times. It also gave away the full breakdown (180, 2700, 4) after the student's first error, so little guidance was left. The AI never responded to "je ne comprends pas" with a simpler explanation. The repeated, identical turns make the conversation disjointed and impersonal, with no praise or encouragement.
